subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu text commands (/stop, /new, /status) no longer bypass queue during active agent run (3.8 regression)

question: Should this active-run Feishu text-command issue remain the tracker for `/status` queue bypass, or should all remaining Feishu text command work move under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/79409?
rationale: The shipped PR 86874 fixed source-reply delivery for authorized control-command bodies, but current main still leaves `/status` and `/new` on the normal Feishu same-chat queue, while a maintainer has already rejected the broad safe-subset fast-path PR and pointed stateful commands at the broader issue.

options.title: Keep this active-run tracker open
options.body: Use this issue for the unresolved active-run queue-bypass behavior until `/status`, `/stop`, and `/new` acceptance criteria are explicitly mapped elsewhere.

options.title: Move remaining work to the broader Feishu command issue
options.body: Close this issue as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/79409 after adding or confirming acceptance coverage there for `/status` during active runs.

options.title: Limit scope to shipped delivery fixes
options.body: Treat PR 86874 plus the current `/stop` control lane as the accepted behavior and leave `/new` or `/status` active-run bypass out of scope unless a new issue is opened.

recommendation.title: Keep this active-run tracker open
recommendation.body: Use this issue for the unresolved active-run queue-bypass behavior until `/status`, `/stop`, and `/new` acceptance criteria are explicitly mapped elsewhere.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the clearest recent maintainer direction on the related rejected PR and named the remaining Feishu command-design track.
